data: Does the number of sentences increase with an increase in the number of tokens?

The question asks whether the number of sentences increases with an increase in the number of tokens. From the caption, we can see that the figure compares two methods: Parse Score Method and Delta Based Method. Both graphs show the relationship between the number of tokens and the percentage of better, worse, no change cases, as well as the number of sentences.

In both graphs, the line labeled "No. of Sents" represents the number of sentences. Observing this line across the range of tokens from 0 to 40, we can see that the number of sentences decreases as the number of tokens increases. This is evident because the line representing the number of sentences is decreasing throughout the range of tokens.

Therefore, the number of sentences does not increase with an increase in the number of tokens. Instead, it decreases.
